v26_field_authority.description: V26 authority migration profile. V26.1 establishes exact field-header ownership; V26.2 moves live Agent business semantics onto authority-bearing JudgementGraph, ActionGraph and OperationGraph without changing the sealed system Agent topology; V26.3 extends deterministic INVOCATION authority upstream so product lifecycle and statistical volatility decide whether an observation may enter QueueAuthority/Agent1 at all; V26.4 extends that same product lifecycle downstream through immutable review-contract freezing and deterministic System Review; V26.5 upgrades the business graph from aggregate graph envelopes to addressable Judgement/Action/Operation nodes and system-generated lineage edges. Historical single-primary fields remain compatibility projections, while the complete JudgementGraph is transported into Agent2 and included in Agent2 semantic identity. Models may emit local node/ref structure but never nodeHash/edgeHash, SystemStage or call-graph authority. FACT and DERIVED remain system-owned; Agent1 owns judgement.*, Agent2 owns plan.*, Agent3 owns operation.* and dynamic operation_stage.*. Existing INFORMATION, INVOCATION, TEMPORAL and MUTATION roots are reused; no new authority domain is created.
